title: HTTP 200, Tool Failed: Taming MCP Agent Traffic with NGINX
abstract: Users and AI agents now call tools over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and every call looks the same to a gateway: a JSON-RPC POST to /mcp that often returns HTTP 200 even when the tool fails.
